structures.overall_structure: single crystal & multiphase nickel-based superalloy microstructure containing a regular matrix with multiple precipitates of significantly different sizes; tertiary precipitates are particularly small and blurry with low contrast; NBS-1 shows a coarse blocky precipitate network

phases_present.morphology: multiple precipitates of significantly different sizes; coarse blocky precipitate network

precipitates.distribution: well recognized; significantly different sizes relative to tertiary precipitates
particularly small and blurry, with low contrast

comparative_performance.comparison_metric: IoU: MatSAM 0.91 (±1.2 %) vs SAM 0.85 (±7.6 %) vs OTSU 0.75 (±3.2 %) vs Adaptive 0.45 (±1.6 %) vs specialist method 0.77
Recall: MatSAM 0.94 (±0.4 %) vs SAM 0.89 (±6.5 %) vs OTSU 0.87 (±8.4 %) vs Adaptive 0.38 (±1.9 %)
Inference time per image: MatSAM 1812.67 ms vs SAM 1575.24 ms vs OTSU 0.53 ms vs Adaptive 0.58 ms

characterization_methods.purpose: phase (precipitate) segmentation evaluation of nickel-based superalloy NBS-1
characterization_methods.key_findings: single crystal & multiphase microstructure; secondary and tertiary precipitates of significantly different sizes; tertiary precipitates are particularly small, blurry and of low contrast

characterization_methods.technique: MatSAM / SAM / OTSU / Adaptive / specialist model segmentation evaluation (IoU, F1, Recall, inference time)
characterization_methods.purpose: quantitative evaluation of segmentation performance on NBS-1 phase masks against expert labels
characterization_methods.key_findings: MatSAM achieves IoU 0.91 (±1.2 %) [F1 0.96 (±0.4 %), Recall 0.94 (±0.4 %)], outperforming SAM IoU 0.85 (±7.6 %) and specialist model IoU 0.77; inference time 1812.67 ms per image

computational_details.boundary_and_initial_conditions: NBS-1 images at 512 × 512 pixels (4 test images); multiphase phase segmentation using structure-aware prompt points (OTSU pre-segmentation plus modulated grid points)
computational_details.validation_against_experiment: MatSAM IoU 0.91 vs expert labels, compared with SAM 0.85 and specialist model 0.77

unmapped_findings: NBS-1 corresponds to Super-2 in the original article [16]; NBS-2 corresponds to Super-4 (b0074).

The specific heat treatment / processing history that produced the NBS-1 secondary and tertiary precipitates is not reported in this paper (process snapshot note; b0075 only states that NBS-1/NBS-2 contain multiple precipitates of significantly different sizes).
